## Patient Stories

#### [Game-Changing Recovery Routine][145]

Shaili’s adventures have taken her many places, including the Mt. Everest Base Camp climb. As an
adventurer she is fearless, but sometimes the world pushes back. A ski accident in February of 2026
left her with a full ACL tear and a partial MCL tear. Breg’s Cold Therapy has helped her manage
swelling, reduce pain, and stay more consistent with her recovery routine.
[ Read More ][146]
[ [Joey Bulla wearing knee brace] ][147]

#### [Regained My Flexibility][148]

Joey was actively competing in martial arts and fight contests when his patella tendon suddenly
ruptured. The pain was so intense that he was unable to walk for quite some time, putting him on the
sidelines. His doctor performed surgery on his knee and put him in a competitor’s knee brace, but
eventually switched the brace out for a Breg T Scope® Premier Post-Op Knee Brace after complaints of
the competitor’s brace being too uncomfortable. After only three months in our brace, Joey’s range
of motion in his knee had gone from only bending 5 degrees to 110 degrees!
[ Read More ][149]
[ [Leah Schulze wearing brace sits on beach with friend] ][150]

#### [New Hips, New Life][151]

Hip surgery is painful and debilitating at any age, but for Leah Schulze, torn labrums and femoral
acetabular impingements in each of her hips forced her to consider the option at just 25 years old.
Leading a very active lifestyle that included weight lifting, golfing, swimming, skiing and running,
she was hesitant to pursue surgery at such a young age, but her pathologies were beginning to really
slow her down. When she decided it was time to have the surgeries, her surgeon instructed her to
wear a T Scope® Post-Op Hip Brace for four weeks after each one to help
[ Read More ][152]
[ [Christina Esposito plays field hockey while wearing knee brace] ][153]

#### [The Journey To GOING PRO][154]

At just 25 years old, Christina Esposito’s knee has been through it all. It all began her freshman
year of college. She was at the top of her lacrosse game and earned a spot on Northwestern
University’s starting line-up as an attacker. She was practicing with her teammates before a game
day when she suddenly felt (and heard) multiple pops in her left knee. In a split second, she had
torn her lateral and medial meniscus, ACL and MCL, and suffered from an LCL sprain and multiple bone
contusions.
[ Read More ][155]
[ [Gina Marie Policastro lifts dumbbell overhead while wearing knee brace] ][156]

#### [Training Tough: Elite Athlete Comes Back From ACL Tear][157]

Teaching high school science in New York City requires a certain amount of mental fortitude, but
it’s all in a day’s work for Gina Marie Policastro. When she isn’t in the classroom, she’s at the
gym, training as an elite Crossfit and Strongman athlete. Even a devastating ACL tear in December
2018 couldn’t keep the NBC Titan Games competitor down for long.
[ Read More ][158]
[ View More Stories ][159]

## Product Spotlight

##### FREESTYLE PLUS^{™} OA KNEE BRACE

Designed for life with Knee Osteoarthritis (OA). Engineered for comfort, ease, and everyday wear;
delivering a balance of support and comfort. From intuitive application to breathable performance
materials, and personalized pain relief, every detail is intended to help patients stay active with
confidence.

## Patient Stories

#### [Game-Changing Recovery Routine][145]

Shaili’s adventures have taken her many places, including the Mt. Everest Base Camp climb. As an
adventurer she is fearless, but sometimes the world pushes back. A ski accident in February of 2026
left her with a full ACL tear and a partial MCL tear. Breg’s Cold Therapy has helped her manage
swelling, reduce pain, and stay more consistent with her recovery routine.
[ Read More ][146]
[ [Joey Bulla wearing knee brace] ][147]

#### [Regained My Flexibility][148]

Joey was actively competing in martial arts and fight contests when his patella tendon suddenly
ruptured. The pain was so intense that he was unable to walk for quite some time, putting him on the
sidelines. His doctor performed surgery on his knee and put him in a competitor’s knee brace, but
eventually switched the brace out for a Breg T Scope® Premier Post-Op Knee Brace after complaints of
the competitor’s brace being too uncomfortable. After only three months in our brace, Joey’s range
of motion in his knee had gone from only bending 5 degrees to 110 degrees!
[ Read More ][149]
[ [Leah Schulze wearing brace sits on beach with friend] ][150]

#### [New Hips, New Life][151]

Hip surgery is painful and debilitating at any age, but for Leah Schulze, torn labrums and femoral
acetabular impingements in each of her hips forced her to consider the option at just 25 years old.
Leading a very active lifestyle that included weight lifting, golfing, swimming, skiing and running,
she was hesitant to pursue surgery at such a young age, but her pathologies were beginning to really
slow her down. When she decided it was time to have the surgeries, her surgeon instructed her to
wear a T Scope® Post-Op Hip Brace for four weeks after each one to help
[ Read More ][152]
[ [Christina Esposito plays field hockey while wearing knee brace] ][153]

#### [The Journey To GOING PRO][154]

At just 25 years old, Christina Esposito’s knee has been through it all. It all began her freshman
year of college. She was at the top of her lacrosse game and earned a spot on Northwestern
University’s starting line-up as an attacker. She was practicing with her teammates before a game
day when she suddenly felt (and heard) multiple pops in her left knee. In a split second, she had
torn her lateral and medial meniscus, ACL and MCL, and suffered from an LCL sprain and multiple bone
contusions.
[ Read More ][155]
[ [Gina Marie Policastro lifts dumbbell overhead while wearing knee brace] ][156]

#### [Training Tough: Elite Athlete Comes Back From ACL Tear][157]

Teaching high school science in New York City requires a certain amount of mental fortitude, but
it’s all in a day’s work for Gina Marie Policastro. When she isn’t in the classroom, she’s at the
gym, training as an elite Crossfit and Strongman athlete. Even a devastating ACL tear in December
2018 couldn’t keep the NBC Titan Games competitor down for long.
[ Read More ][158]
[ View More Stories ][159]

Designed for life with Knee Osteoarthritis (OA). Engineered for comfort, ease, and everyday wear;
delivering a balance of support and comfort. From intuitive application to breathable performance
materials, and personalized pain relief, every detail is intended to help patients stay active with
confidence.

# Improving the lives of the people we touch

Convatec is a global medical products and technologies company focused on therapies for the
management of chronic conditions, leading in advanced wound care, stoma care, continence and
critical care, and infusion devices.
[ Learn about us ][223]

## Forever Caring

Living with a condition, no matter how long or short it may be, is a journey. One that will be
different for everyone. That can feel unpredictable and unfair. And at times even life changing. But
we believe it never needs to be YOU changing. That you deserve better, holistic care. So, you can
keep being you.



[Stoma Care] ;

### Stoma Care

Information, support and advice on post operative lifestyle for ileostomy, urostomy, colostomy and
general stoma care patients.
[Read more][224] [Advanced Wound Care] ;

### Advanced Wound Care

Leading the way in advanced wound and skin care innovation. Learn more about all our high quality
products to help heal wounds faster.
[Read more][225]




## Healthy Bonds. Our bonds determine who we are.

;

There’s no bond more important than the one with your own body. Convatec helps you create a healthy
bond with yourself, your stoma. And then, with the world around you.

Start creating a healthy bond with your stoma by finding the answers you need quickly with me+
Answers.

The me+™ programme offers you the right support so you feel stronger, more confident and ready for
what’s ahead. The ostomy products and support you need, tips and advice for stoma care, and a
community you can grow with. Have questions about living with an stoma? Our me+ specialists and
stoma nurses are waiting to help you, call 18002674989 or write to us at
customerserviceindia@convatec.com

[ Join me+ today ][226]

## Feature Highlight: AWC, CC, + Flexi-Seal

Hydrofiber® Technology

### Our Hydrofiber® Technology

**Hydrofiber^{®} Technology is a soft, absorbent material that transforms into a gel on contact with
wound fluid.**

For more than 25 years, Convatec has been helping clinicians to improve patient outcomes, enabling
patients to move on with their lives through the use of Hydrofiber^{®} Technology – globally proven
and trusted. Discover how the unique, innovative Hydrofiber^{®} Technology can help you make a real
impact on the lives of people living with a wound.

Our Hydrofiber® Technology Learn more

[ Learn more ][227] [three doctors] ; Flexi-Seal™

### Flexi-Seal™ FMS

Flexi-Seal™ Fecal Management System (FMS) is an indwelling fecal management catheter intended for
use to manage fecal incontinence through the collection of liquid to semi-liquid stool and to
provide access to administer medications.

Flexi-Seal™ FMS Learn more

[ Learn more ][228] [Flexi-Seal™ FMS] ;

## Sign up and be the first to know about our exciting innovations.

Learning how to live fully with a condition takes education, resources and support. And with me+, we
make sure you don’t have to figure it out alone. Getting the benefits of me+ is easy. Join today for
complete support.

Data Insights Market is one of the leading providers of syndicated and customized research reports,
consulting services, and analytical information on markets and companies across the world. Data
Insights Market partners with clients in many countries and industry verticals such as A & D,
Chemical & material, Energy Power, F & B, Retail, Healthcare and many more to provide high value
market research reports and consulting services. Our skilled analysts work towards understanding the
specific needs of each client to produce relevant insights that most suit his individual needs.
Since its inception, Data Insights Market has continued to innovate, increased its product and
service portfolio, and remained focused on the needs of its clients to root out poor-quality data
and establish itself as a winning partner for businesses. DIM has a legacy of serving and
facilitating clients from all over the world and played a vital role in their success story. Our
clients include many types of organizations, the majority of which are Fortune 500 companies.

sure that the analysis is comprehensive and accurate. We can provide services of importance to our
clients well within the time limit by keeping a close eye on relevant press releases, official
publications, decades of trade data, technical and white papers. We also offer services based on the

quantitative marketing research to understand clients properly. The key objectives are to examine
